h: The Joy of Yitzchak and Three Levels of Holiness

p: The first meal, of the night of holy Shabbos,
כְּנֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as corresponding to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him.
And in the Tanchuma (end of Pekudei, 11)
Teves, Shevat and Adar…" and so on;
to combine the joy of the Mishkan
בְּשִׂמְחַת הַיּוֹם שֶׁנּוֹלַד בּוֹ יִצְחָק וְכוּלֵּי
with the joy of the day on which Yitzchak was born…" and so on;
Now this needs to be understood:
in order to mix joy with joy
that one does not mix joy with joy,
one does not marry on Chol HaMoed.
and it is only an increase of joy,
and does not fall under the rule
And this is because Yitzchak is called
as is written in the Midrash HaNe'elam
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלו, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 154b):
is the beginning of joy…" and so on.
of the holiness of the camps;
is "the Daughter crowned with the Avos"
that is, through the three Shabbos meals,
which correspond to the holiness of the Avos;
for the three holinesses of Shabbos
are the holinesses of the three camps,
הֵם גַּם כֵּן קְדוּשַּׁת הַשָּׁלֹשׁ מַחֲנוֹת
are also the holiness of the three camps;
for the three holinesses of Shabbos
is the aspect of Atika Kadisha,
שֶׁהֵם גַּם כֵּן נֶגֶד שָׁלֹשׁ קְדוּשּׁוֹת אֵלּוּ
which also correspond to these three holinesses;
in the highest heavens above…" and so on,
corresponding to the aspect of Atika Kadisha,
which is called by these terms:
is that He is above perception;
and it corresponds to the camp of the Shechinah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קכא, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 121a):
it came forth from a place
that is called the Holy of Holies";
(as is written in the holy Zohar
פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קנח, ב)
which the holy Zohar cited above mentions,
is the aspect of Ze'ir Anpin,
וְעַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (מְגִילָּה טז, ב)
according to what they said in the Gemara (Megillah 16b):
"'And honor' (Esther 8:16): these are tefillin…" and so on;
כִּי שֵׁם ה׳ נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ וְכוּלֵּי
"'that the Name of Hashem is called upon you' (Devarim 28:10)…
these are the tefillin of the head";
for tefillin are called the Name Havayah,
and it is the attribute of Tiferes,
regarding the blessing over the Torah before it,
"When I call the Name of Hashem,
And it corresponds to the camp of the Levi'im,
who are free only for Torah;
they took no portion in the land,
"They shall teach Your judgments to Yaakov
"And you shall come to the Kohanim, the Levi'im…";
"For the lips of the Kohen guard knowledge,
and they seek Torah from his mouth."
And the Chamber of Hewn Stone,
was also in the camp of the Levi'im;
for there is no sitting in the Azarah
except for kings of the house of David alone,
and from the Chamber of Hewn Stone
Torah goes forth to all Yisrael
were not all from the tribe of Levi,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם הָיוּ פְּנוּיִם רַק לַתּוֹרָה
nevertheless they were free only for Torah,
and they too are called by the name Kohanim,
as the Rambam, of blessed memory, wrote
"And not the tribe of Levi alone,
whose spirit moves him…" and so on,
"and who has cast off from his neck
the yoke of the many calculations…" and so on,
and Hashem will be his portion and his inheritance…" and so on.
And we have said that the source of his words
"'And the sons of David were kohanim' (Shmuel II 8:18)
so too a talmid chacham…" and so on.
in the holy Zohar cited above
is the aspect of Chakal Tapuchin,
and it is the holiness of the camp of Yisrael.
the holy Zohar cited above says:
"to be nourished from the supernal light,
from the light of the holy King,
is the aspect of Ze'ir Anpin,
"to be bound in the bond of life"
as is written in Sefer HaBahir:
"'the bond of life with Hashem your God' (Shmuel I 25:29)
'with Hashem,' which is secondary to the Name Havayah";
as is written in the holy Zohar:
this is the Shabbos of Erev Shabbos…" and so on.
the order of the holinesses from above to below:
and according to the reckoning of the meals
which is the aspect of Chakal Tapuchin;
and the meal of the holy King,
which is the aspect of Ze'ir Anpin;
is the holiness of the camp of Yisrael,
to be circumcised at eight days
and was born in the holiness of Yisrael;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
not so Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is counted the first of the converts
is the holiness of the camp of the Levi'im,
And with Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
the two thousand years of Torah;
and he fulfilled the entire Torah
and he innovated the entire Torah from his own mind,
he had no teacher…" and so on;
"'Let there be light': this is Avraham";
in the passage "and there was light"
correspond to the five books of the Torah
for from him began the light of the Torah;
therefore he corresponds to the camp of the Levi'im.
his image is engraved on the Throne of Glory;
that is, the camp of the Shechinah,
which is the Holy of Holies,
And the holinesses of the three meals,
according to the reckoning of the meals
corresponds to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who is the camp of Yisrael;
and in the morning, that of the holy King,
who is the holiness of the camp of the Levi'im;
who is the holiness of the camp of the Shechinah,
